intended_use: Mechanism pilot only. Same-L3 skills may contain source-specific targets, timing, and parameters.

skills.belief: Treat severe edge weakness as nutrient stress only after soil, canopy, drone, target-vs-reference, and ground evidence support nutrient limitation.
skills.action_pattern: wait/recheck action window and quota, apply targeted fertigation to the confirmed severe edge block, then recheck target state and quota
constraints: do not use fertigation for weed, disease, insect, or pure water stress
success_checks: target nutrient stress improves or stabilizes

skills.belief: Confirmed stand gaps require replanting rather than fertilizer or spray treatment.
skills.action_pattern: wait/recheck replant window, replant the confirmed severe edge gap, commit and recheck stand
constraints: do not replant without stand evidence
do not replace replant with fertilizer
success_checks: seed use and planted status are visible

skills.belief: Use remaining quota for a later mild-edge topup only if R1 evidence still supports nutrient stress.
skills.action_pattern: wait/recheck action window, apply smaller targeted fertigation to confirmed mild edge block, recheck state and quota
constraints: do not spend quota without nutrient evidence
do not treat unrelated stress with fertilizer
success_checks: mild edge nutrient stress improves or stabilizes

skills.belief: Harvest requires maturity/harvest_allowed, workable weather/soil, known grain moisture, and capacity.
skills.action_pattern: wait/recheck until legal harvest window, harvest in 4-ridge blocks, unload, dry if moisture requires it, store, recheck inventory
constraints: do not store wet grain directly
preserve harvest -> unload -> dry if needed -> store
